name: OpenWork Cloud (Den)
description: Full OpenWork Cloud stack: Den control plane + web app + MySQL. Provides user auth, worker provisioning, and the cloud web interface.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.description: Database for the Den control plane

den-controller.name: Den Control Plane
den-controller.description: Better Auth + worker CRUD + provisioning hooks

DATABASE_URL.description: MySQL connection URL (use Railway's MySQL service reference: mysql://root:${{mysql.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}@${{mysql.RAILWAY_PRIVATE_DOMAIN}}:3306/openwork_den)

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: 32+ character secret for Better Auth session signing

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Public URL of the den-web service (for OAuth callbacks)

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth app client ID (optional, for social sign-in)

WORKER_URL_TEMPLATE.description: Template with {workerId} placeholder for stub mode

DEN_API_BASE.description: Internal URL of the Den control plane (use Railway service reference: http://${{den-controller.RAILWAY_PRIVATE_DOMAIN}}:8788)

DEN_AUTH_ORIGIN.description: Public-facing origin for auth callbacks (your den-web public URL)

DEN_AUTH_FALLBACK_BASE.description: Fallback Den origin if primary returns errors

NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENWORK_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL.description: Canonical URL for auth callbacks (same as den-web public URL)

NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENWORK_APP_CONNECT_URL.description: Base URL for 'Open in App' deep links
